text:
Sorry about the lost email. We can reissue lost gift card codes if you, as the purchaser, give us the order number for the gift card purchase. It starts with `LF-` followed by six digits, like LF-204518, and should be in your order confirmation or under "My Orders".

Please send that number and we'll get the code reissued. The policy I have doesn't give a timeframe for reissuing, so I can't promise one. Please don't send any full card numbers, security codes or passwords.
